Negri, A. and Ligthart, T. (2021). Decarbonisation options for the Dutch polyolefins industry. MIDDEN report, PBL publication number 4236, TNO 2020 P11985. The Hague: PBL Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency and TNO EnergieTransitie. Dated 02 February 2021. www.middenweb.nl

Loaded: electricity and heat per t polymer for LDPE, LLDPE, HDPE and PP polymerisation (Table 13, the report's averages of eco-profiles and company data); naphtha cracker useful energy (Table 8, reprinted) and levelized cost; levelized cost and break-even carbon price for bio-ethylene from sugar-beet ethanol and bio-waste gasification + MTO (Table 20), plus the MTO route's energy and biomass per t olefins (s.4.2.6); pyrolysis plant capex/opex at 100, 1,000 and 10,000 kg/h (Table 21, reprinted) and costs and GHG reductions per t input waste for mechanical, solvent-based, pyrolysis and gasification recycling (Table 22); heat pump COP 3-6 and biogas CHP ~63% (s.4.1, reprinted). Not loaded (in _other-values): polymerisation GHG (scope includes indirect), plant-level capacity and energy (Tables 1, 3, 5, 6; against nominal capacity), 1999/2014 BREF and eco-profile benchmarks, reactor conditions, monomer inputs, life-cycle GHG, yields, payback/NPV. Market/product data (ch.3) and the appendix scenario not extracted. No TRL, lifetime or O&M per option printed.

(1) Colophon says 'The Hague, 2020' and suggests citing (2020), while the cover dates the report 02 February 2021. (2) No cost basis for Table 21 capex; plant capacity in kg/h without operating hours; whether kg/h refers to feed is not stated. (3) Table 22 prints the solvent-based reduction as '≈-1.0.' t CO2-eq/t while the text (p.47) says -1.0 kg CO2-eq/ton. (4) Table 13 GHG values combine eco-profile averages and company data with unstated scope. (5) Table 9 labels the LDPE figure 'steam demand' while Tables 10-13 say 'heat demand'. (6) PP melting point printed as 210-290 degC (p.22), physically implausible (about 160 degC). (7) Foust et al. costs in USD2007/l without stating the product. (8) Heating-value basis not stated. (9) Levelized costs in Table 20 are Oliveira et al. (2020) values 'adjusted for the European market' without method.
